findings.title: Render Fireworm's existing artwork when defending
findings.why_it_matters: When Flamehuffer or Common or Garden Dragon captures Fireworm, the defender becomes a generic lettered rook placeholder even though Fireworm's illustrated texture is already preloaded. Other illustrated presenters explicitly preserve Fireworm as a defender, so the capture loses the named character's visual identity during the battle. Resolve the Fireworm identity to fireworm-ready for a matching white rook, as BishopPresenter does.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a presenter test that advances the return tween, changes the origin provider to a resized destination, and asserts the attacker reaches that new point; also verify Skip and cleanup cancel that update.
findings.title: Verify actor return after rotation instead of only canvas size
findings.why_it_matters: A capture can pass the rotation test even if the attacker returns to a stale destination or moves off the resized stage, because the test checks only the phase and canvas dimensions. The new presenter recalculates the destination during its return, but its unit tests mock tweens without executing their updates and never assert the return location. A destination-aware presenter test, as used for Bishop and Knight, would catch a regression in this required mobile behavior.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a Playwright case that aborts one required Batch 4 image while delaying the optional Bishop image, asserts one completion, then releases the delayed response and verifies no restarted presentation and a working Undo.
findings.title: Exercise failed required artwork while a defender request is pending
findings.why_it_matters: A failed required attacker image must complete the pending move exactly once and cancel the parallel optional Bishop load. The new tests cover successful loads and manual Skip while loads are held, but never drive the image error or timeout branch; a regression in that failure path could leave the board locked or let a late defender response restart the attack. Exercise an aborted required image while holding the optional Bishop image, then release the late response and assert completion, no restart, and Undo.
